# JSON for Modern C++

`json.hpp` is the unmodified single-header distribution of nlohmann/json v3.12.0:
https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp

MIT license: `LICENSE.MIT`. Embedded in hc so C++ solution execution is offline
and does not require users to install a JSON library.
